margin_estimator_tool.series.series_request_handler module

This module contains logic for retrieving data about series and giving output to the user in desired format.

process_and_provide_output() → None

Processes the data from /series and exports it according to the specified format.

If a template for portfolio is also requested, it generates it.

send_request() → List[Dict[str, Any]]

Sends a GET request to the /series endpoint with optional filters, date, and version. It also checks for the error in the response.

Returns:

list of data from series endpoint.

Returns empty list in case of error in the response.

response
